name: Article 2, after § 8 – 343
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 8d. This Regulation shall not establish Union requirements governing national, regional or local reconstruction, spatial planning or land use. Any exchange of expertise on recovery shall take place only at the request of the Member State concerned and on a voluntary basis. The establishment of a national recovery readiness framework shall not be required as a condition for assistance or funding under this Regulation.
